en-US.description: Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
en-US.longDescription: Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
en-US.name: codeg
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release adds support for Claude Fable 5.2, updates Codex and several other agents, and fixes Qoder failing to start on Windows and MiniMax questions not showing as cards.
Improved
- Claude Code is updated to 2.1.321 with adapter 0.102.0, so the Fable model is now Fable 5.2, and a saved Fable 5.1 selection through an API gateway switches to Fable 5.2 automatically instead of falling back to the default model.
- Codex is updated to adapter 2.6.0 (Codex 0.166.0), and its async questions now display as answer cards that stay in sync during the conversation and in history.
- Grok background sub-agents show live progress after the turn that launched them ends. (#1109)
- Updated OpenCode to 2.2.6, CodeBuddy to 2.182.0, Qoder to 1.1.86, the ZCode bridge to 0.82.3 and Command Code to 1.88.5.
Fixed
- Qoder starts normally again on Windows, and its diagnostics show the actual program being launched or the reason it could not be found. (#1101 by @leehom0123)
- MiniMax questions to the user appear as interactive question cards instead of raw JSON, including each option's description. (#1111 by @xy3xy3)
- When a Codex conversation's model provider no longer matches, codeg shows a clear notice instead of silently starting an empty session that loses the history.
- Reopened Claude Code context compaction summaries no longer include internal prompt text meant for the model.
- OpenCode 2.2.6 conversation history displays its complete content.
Thanks to @leehom0123 (#1101) and @xy3xy3 (#1111) for their contributions, and to @momomomo820 (#1109) for the report.

zh-CN.description: 在一个地方聚合并浏览 AI 编程代理会话（如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）。支持桌面应用、自建服务器或 Docker 部署。
zh-CN.longDescription: Codeg（Code Generation，代码生成）是一款企业级多代理编码工作区。它将本地 AI 编程代理（包括 Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode、Gemini CLI、OpenClaw、Cline 等）统一集成于桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 容器中，支持通过任意浏览器进行远程开发；具备对话聚合、并行 Git 工作树开发、MCP/技能管理、聊天频道交互（Telegram、飞书、iLink 等），以及集成的 Git/文件/终端工作流。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
这一版支持 Claude Fable 5.2，更新 Codex 及多个智能体，并修复 Qoder 在 Windows 上无法启动、MiniMax 提问不弹出卡片等问题。
改进
- Claude Code 更新至 2.1.321，适配器更新至 0.102.0，Fable 模型升级为 Fable 5.2，通过 API 网关使用时，已保存的 Fable 5.1 选择会自动切换到 Fable 5.2，不再回落到默认模型。
- Codex 适配器更新至 2.6.0（Codex 0.166.0），异步提问会显示为答题卡片，会话中和历史记录里都能正确展示。
- Grok 后台子智能体在启动它的回合结束后，仍会实时显示运行进度。（#1109）
- OpenCode 更新至 2.2.6，CodeBuddy 更新至 2.182.0，Qoder 更新至 1.1.86，ZCode 桥接更新至 0.82.3，Command Code 更新至 1.88.5。
修复
- Qoder 在 Windows 上恢复正常启动，诊断信息也会显示实际启动的程序或无法找到的原因。（#1101 by @leehom0123）
- MiniMax 向用户提问时会弹出可交互的提问卡片，不再只显示 JSON 参数，并展示每个选项的说明。（#1111 by @xy3xy3）
- Codex 会话的模型供应商不再匹配时，会显示明确提示，不再悄悄新开一个空会话导致历史丢失。
- 重新打开 Claude Code 的上下文压缩摘要时，不再显示写给模型的内部提示文本。
- OpenCode 2.2.6 的历史会话能完整显示内容。
感谢 @leehom0123（#1101）和 @xy3xy3（#1111）的贡献，以及 @momomomo820（#1109）的反馈。
